sections.Aims and Fit of Module: Aims: This module aims to develop through practical and critical contextual work a critical understanding of the economic theories and models of creative and aesthetic consumptions. Objectives: Students will learn the academic research skills and methods to analyse and apply the ecomonic perspective onto the needs and supply of creative and aesthetic production.
sections.Learning outcomes: A Employ critically the traditional or practice-based research methods to conduct critical research inquiry into creative and aesthetics economy B Produce original written work that reflects the critical understanding of creative- and aesthetics-driven economic development C Evaluate critically the creative consumption trends through historical and contemporary critical theory
sections.Method of teaching and learning: This module will be delivered through a combination of lectures, tutorials and seminars.
